content.title: Camera Memory | Fixed Frame Narrative
content.summary: A fixed camera viewfinder spans several everyday spaces. The same character performs one small action in each location, then physically ends the recording by covering the camera lens with a palm.

quick_start.input_format: Same character + fixed camera interface + at least 3 connected spaces + one small action per space + clear threshold transition + palm covers the camera lens at the end
quick_start.recommended_input: An elderly museum conservator moves through archives, restoration rooms, stairways, and sculpture courtyards within a fixed pocket camera interface, performing a small movement at each location before fully covering the lens with a gloved palm on the rooftop.
required_anchors: The same original camera interface remains unchanged throughout.
The same character passes through at least three consecutive spaces.
Each space features a small action.
At least one threshold or stair transition.
End with a physical touch on or cover of the camera lens to conclude the recording.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Fixed-viewfinder memory films in which one character crosses connected everyday spaces and physically ends the recording by touching or covering the camera lens.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one recorder-style viewing interface over the entire film, then let one subject move through a compact route of clearly different everyday places. Each place contributes one small human action and one spatial clue; finish with a direct gesture into the lens so the fixed interface feels like a remembered recording rather than decorative graphics.

invariants.rule: Keep one original recorder interface visually stable for the whole sequence.
invariants.purpose: Binds separate places into one recording session.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the interface changes every shot, it becomes decorative motion graphics.

invariants.rule: Keep one subject and one observer relationship continuous across at least three places.
invariants.purpose: Turns location changes into a route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated people and places become a travel montage.

invariants.rule: Give each place one small readable action rather than a posed beauty shot.
invariants.purpose: Creates memory detail and human continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Pure posing makes the interface feel like a filter.

invariants.rule: Use one physical threshold or travel action between interior and exterior scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: Abrupt location swaps lose the feeling of an outing.

invariants.rule: End with a direct lens interaction that physically closes the recording.
invariants.purpose: Provides an intimate and causal endpoint.
invariants.ablation_failure: A fade without interaction does not complete the observer relationship.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
